inputs.original_text: Israel’s parliament began debating a Bill today that would make the death penalty the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. The legislation was introduced by National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir’s religious party, and passing it would be a victory for the far-right minister. Opponents call it racist and draconian and say it is unlikely to deter attacks by Palestinian militants.
